environment: ARM64 API 35 redroid; Linux 6.17.0-1020-oracle; warm fixtures

methodology.diagnostics: 30 fork-exit, 30 static exec, 30 dynamic exec timeline samples; 30 true images via dash. Profile writes occur at exit, affecting exit/reap. Native allowed syscalls excluded from dispatcher counters.
methodology.comparison: Same APK, original 6bf6203 loader vs final loader vs unchanged accelerated Rootless. 3 runs x 18 triplets; all 6 orders; profiling/tracing disabled. Guest monotonic clock includes shell plus 30 true commands, excludes APK preparation.

discarded_experiments.pid-paired-1: plus fork-aware PID reuse for process_vm copy
discarded_experiments.open-paired-1: plus final read-only path open shortcut
discarded_experiments.filter-paired-1: short copy and PID reuse plus seccomp constant-allow order (read-open shortcut removed)
discarded_experiments.bootstrap-paired-1: initial mapping inheritance experiment, before retaining host TLS and removing short-copy/PID experiments

methodology.final_scope: Only bootstrap inheritance policy and startup diagnostics. No short-copy/PID/open/filter-order optimization retained.

fixtures.source: Existing Ubuntu ARM64 host packages; local test fixture only

validation.bootstrap_host: Passed actual child/grandchild mapping, BSS, guest, alternate-stack, vDSO and parent isolation checks.
validation.canonical_gradle: Passed; unchanged runtime/image tests UP-TO-DATE (180 passed + 1 skipped / 4 passed).
validation.native: Warnings-as-errors, import/TLS audit and APK signature passed.
validation.full_integration: 118 top-level launches; 2 PTY, 2 network and 2 signal scenarios; 16.073 s.
validation.broad_workload: 157 top-level launches, 145 samples; 23.413 s. Known Rootless application cleanup failure explicitly skipped.

failures_and_resolution: APK installation failed twice from insufficient shared disk space; removed only task-generated reproducible APKs and retried successfully.
One instrumentation run after failed installation rejected the old loader digest; one manually mistyped digest was also rejected before execution.
Initial timeline fixture buffered stdout and lost a record boundary when stderr reports interleaved; flush after each post-reap record fixed all 90 sample counts.

Initial host bootstrap test child SIGSEGV exposed the need to retain host TLS (kernel rseq may reference it); fixed and passed child/grandchild tests. Guarded test allocation avoids merging its discardable page into retained TLS VMA.
Context7 had no exact seccomp cache documentation and no useful DONTFORK contract; Linux v6.17 source and Linux man-pages supplied primary references.
